# Components

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-dash-dots-reference.mjs from the Dash Dots docs (Dot 1.0.0-beta.3). Don't edit by hand. -->

Every component a `view.dml` can use, with its props, events and children. Source: https://docs.monime.io/docs/products/dash-dots/reference/components


Everything you can put on a page. Props are attributes. Events are attributes that start with `on` and name a handler in your controller:

```xml
<Button variant="primary" loading="{{ paying }}" onClick="pay">Pay</Button>
```

A few rules hold for every component:

- Every prop is optional.
- A text prop can mix words and state, as in `label="Pay {{ amount }}"`. Any other prop takes a plain value or a single binding, like `disabled="{{ !ready }}"`. A prop on its own, such as `disabled`, means `true`.
- Your handler gets the event. Its `detail` holds what the component reports, listed on each component's page, and its `data` holds the component's [`data-*` attributes](https://docs.monime.io/docs/products/dash-dots/developers/views#data-attributes).
- **Children** on each page says what can go between the component's tags: nothing, text, or other components.

New to dots? [Views](https://docs.monime.io/docs/products/dash-dots/developers/views) explains bindings, conditions and lists, and [Components](https://docs.monime.io/docs/products/dash-dots/developers/components) shows how the pieces fit together.

## Layout

| Component | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| [`View`](#view) | A box that lays out what it holds in a column or a row, and can look like a card. |
| [`Stack`](#stack) | Layers what it holds on top of each other, such as a badge over a picture. |
| [`Scroll`](#scroll) | A row the person scrolls sideways, such as a shelf of products. |
| [`Carousel`](#carousel) | Slides the person swipes between, one at a time, with dots below. |
| [`Grid`](#grid) | Tiles in equal columns, for a menu of services. |
| [`GridItem`](#griditem) | One tile in a Grid: an icon or picture with a short label. |
| [`Footer`](#footer) | Keeps the page's main button at the bottom of the screen while the page scrolls. |
| [`Divider`](#divider) | A thin line between two parts of a page. |

## Value lists

Props that share a list of values.

### Spacing

Space between or around components.

`none` `small` `medium` `large`

### Sizes

The sizes of icons, avatars and spinners.

`small` `medium` `large`

### Tones

Colors for meaning.

`default` `muted` `info` `success` `warning` `danger`

### Status tones

Colors for status, the tones without `muted`.

`default` `info` `success` `warning` `danger`

### Text tones

A text's color. `onPrimary` reads on a `primary` background. A dot's own colors come from its theme. See [custom colors](https://docs.monime.io/docs/products/dash-dots/developers/theming#custom-colors).

`default` `muted` `info` `success` `warning` `danger` `onPrimary`

### Backgrounds

A box's fill: a color of the theme, a tone as a soft tint, or one of the dot's own colors. See [custom colors](https://docs.monime.io/docs/products/dash-dots/developers/theming#custom-colors).

`background` `surface` `primary` `muted` `info` `success` `warning` `danger`

### Borders

A box's outline. `subtle` is the hairline cards have.

`none` `subtle` `strong`

### Corner radii

A box's corners, scaled by the theme's shape. `full` makes pills and circles.

`none` `small` `medium` `large` `full`

### Aspect ratios

The shape of a picture's or a video's box.

`1:1` `4:3` `3:2` `16:9` `3:4` `2:3` `9:16`

### Icon names

Dash's icons.

`arrow-down` `arrow-left` `arrow-right` `arrow-up` `bank` `bell` `bolt` `calendar` `card` `cart` `cash` `check` `chevron-down` `chevron-left` `chevron-right` `chevron-up` `clock` `close` `copy` `download` `edit` `error` `external-link` `eye` `eye-off` `file` `gift` `globe` `grid` `headphones` `heart` `help` `history` `home` `image` `info` `link` `list` `location` `lock` `logout` `mail` `microphone` `minus` `mobile` `more` `music` `phone` `playlist` `plus` `qr-code` `receipt` `refresh` `search` `send` `settings` `share` `star` `success` `ticket` `trash` `upload` `user` `users` `video` `wallet` `warning` `water` `wifi`

## View

A box that lays out what it holds in a column or a row, and can look like a card.

Every page has one `View` around the rest. Nest more `View`s to group content into rows, columns and cards.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View variant="card" direction="row" align="center" justify="between">
  <Text weight="medium">Balance</Text>
  <Text weight="bold" numeric>SLE 1,250.00</Text>
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | [spacing](#spacing) |  |
| `direction` | `column`, `row` |  |
| `align` | `stretch`, `start`, `center`, `end` | Across `direction`. |
| `justify` | `start`, `center`, `end`, `between` | Along `direction`. `between` puts the first and last child at the ends. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | Lets children that don't fit flow onto another line. |
| `grow` | `boolean` | Fills the space the parent has left, along the parent's direction. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |
| `variant` | `plain`, `card` | `card` is a surface with a hairline and rounded corners. The box props change any of those. |
| `background` | [background](#backgrounds), or a [custom color](https://docs.monime.io/docs/products/dash-dots/developers/theming#custom-colors) |  |
| `border` | [border](#borders) |  |
| `radius` | [corner radius](#corner-radii) |  |
| `width` | `fill`, or a `number` of points |  |
| `height` | `fill`, or a `number` of points |  |
| `minHeight` | `number` |  |
| `maxWidth` | `number` |  |
| `aspect` | [aspect ratio](#aspect-ratios) |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTap` | Nothing |  |

> Setting `aspect` makes `height` pointless: the aspect sets the height. The build warns when both are set.

## Stack

Layers what it holds on top of each other, such as a badge over a picture.

The first child sits at the bottom, and each child covers the whole stack. Place a child's content with `justify` and `align` on that child.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Stack radius="large" aspect="16:9">
  <Image src="statics/photo.jpg" alt="A photo" fit="cover" />
  <View justify="end" padding="medium">
    <Badge tone="success">New</Badge>
  </View>
</Stack>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | [corner radius](#corner-radii) |  |
| `width` | `fill`, or a `number` of points |  |
| `height` | `fill`, or a `number` of points |  |
| `aspect` | [aspect ratio](#aspect-ratios) |  |

### Events

None.

> Setting `aspect` makes `height` pointless: the aspect sets the height. The build warns when both are set.

## Scroll

A row the person scrolls sideways, such as a shelf of products.

Each child keeps its own width. Give cards a `width`.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Scroll gap="small" snap="start">
  <View variant="card" width="140"><Text weight="medium">Airtime</Text></View>
  <View variant="card" width="140"><Text weight="medium">Data</Text></View>
  <View variant="card" width="140"><Text weight="medium">Electricity</Text></View>
</Scroll>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | [spacing](#spacing) | Default: `medium`. |
| `snap` | `none`, `start`, `center` | Where children come to rest after a swipe. Default: `none`. |
| `index` | `number` | The child to scroll to. Changing it scrolls there. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ index }` in `detail` | The child now at the start. |

## Carousel

Slides the person swipes between, one at a time, with dots below.

Put one child in it for each slide, such as an `Image` or a card.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Carousel indicator="dots" gap="small">
  <Image src="statics/photo.jpg" alt="First slide" aspect="16:9" fit="cover" shape="rounded" />
  <Image src="statics/photo.jpg" alt="Second slide" aspect="16:9" fit="cover" shape="rounded" />
</Carousel>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | Moves to the next slide every `interval` milliseconds, pausing while touched. Default: `false`. |
| `interval` | `number` | In milliseconds. Default: `4000`. |
| `loop` | `boolean` | After the last slide comes the first again. Default: `false`. |
| `indicator` | `dots`, `none` | Default: `dots`. |
| `gap` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space between slides, seen while one slides in. Default: `none`. |
| `effect` | `slide`, `scale` | `scale` shrinks a slide as it leaves the middle and grows the one coming in, as you swipe. Default: `slide`. |
| `index` | `number` | The slide to show. Changing it moves the carousel there. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ index }` in `detail` | The slide now showing. |

## Grid

Tiles in equal columns, for a menu of services.

Put a `GridItem` inside it for each tile. It suits a home screen of services: Airtime, Electricity, Water, Bills.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Grid columns="3" gap="small">
  <GridItem icon="send" label="Send" onTap="open" data-page="send" />
  <GridItem icon="wallet" label="Top up" onTap="open" data-page="top-up" />
  <GridItem icon="receipt" label="Bills" badge="2" onTap="open" data-page="bills" />
</Grid>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: {},
  actions: {
    open(_state, event: DataEvent<{ page: 'send' | 'top-up' | 'bills' }>) {
      this.navigation.push(event.data.page);
    },
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `number` | Default: `4`. |
| `gap` | [spacing](#spacing) | Default: `medium`. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

None.

## GridItem

One tile in a Grid: an icon or picture with a short label.

Goes inside a `Grid`. Keep the `label` to a word or two, as tiles are narrow.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

`GridItem` is used inside `Grid`:

```xml title="view.dml"
<Grid columns="3" gap="small">
  <GridItem icon="send" label="Send" onTap="open" data-page="send" />
  <GridItem icon="wallet" label="Top up" onTap="open" data-page="top-up" />
  <GridItem icon="receipt" label="Bills" badge="2" onTap="open" data-page="bills" />
</Grid>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: {},
  actions: {
    open(_state, event: DataEvent<{ page: 'send' | 'top-up' | 'bills' }>) {
      this.navigation.push(event.data.page);
    },
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `icon` | [icon name](#icon-names) |  |
| `image` | `string` | A picture in place of `icon`. It takes the same addresses as an `Image`'s `src`. |
| `badge` | `string` | A short note on the item's corner, such as "New" or a count. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTap` | Nothing |  |

## Footer

Keeps the page's main button at the bottom of the screen while the page scrolls.

Put it last in the page's root `View`, around the page's main button.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Footer>
  <Button>Continue</Button>
</Footer>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

None.

## Divider

A thin line between two parts of a page.

Use one between a receipt's items and its total, for example.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View variant="card" gap="small">
  <Text>Subtotal</Text>
  <Divider />
  <Text weight="bold">Total</Text>
</View>
```

### Props

None.

### Events

None.

## Text

Text, from a large amount or a title down to a caption.

Use one `Text` for each line or paragraph. To style part of a line, put a `Text` inside another.

**Children:** Text, which can include `Text`, `Link` and `Icon` within a line · **Inline:** can sit within a line of text, inside a `Text`

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View gap="small">
  <Text variant="title">Your balance</Text>
  <Text variant="display" numeric>SLE 1,250.00</Text>
  <Text tone="muted">Updated a minute ago</Text>
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `display`, `title`, `subtitle`, `lead`, `body`, `caption` | `display` is for large amounts, such as a balance. `lead` is an article's opening paragraph. Default: `body`. |
| `tone` | [text tone](#text-tones), or a [custom color](https://docs.monime.io/docs/products/dash-dots/developers/theming#custom-colors) |  |
| `weight` | `regular`, `medium`, `bold` |  |
| `align` | `start`, `center`, `end` |  |
| `maxLines` | `number` | Cuts the text off with an ellipsis after this many lines. |
| `decoration` | `none`, `underline`, `strikethrough` | `strikethrough` shows a price that no longer applies. |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | Gives every digit the same width, so amounts line up in a list. |
| `leading` | `tight`, `normal`, `relaxed` | The space between lines, closer or wider than the variant's own. |
| `italic` | `boolean` |  |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | Lets the person select the text and copy it, such as a passage of an article. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

None.

## Link

Text the person taps to open a web page or run an action.

Give it an https `href` and Dash opens the page in the phone's browser. Leave `href` out and it sends `onTap` instead.

**Children:** Text, which can include `Text`, `Link` and `Icon` within a line · **Inline:** can sit within a line of text, inside a `Text`

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Text>Read our <Link href="https://example.com/terms">terms of service</Link>.</Text>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` |  |
| `tone` | [tone](#tones) | The primary color unless a tone sets another. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTap` | Nothing | Only without an https `href`. |

## Icon

One of Dash's built-in icons, in three sizes and any tone.

The full list of names is on the [components overview](#icon-names).

**Children:** Nothing · **Inline:** can sit within a line of text, inside a `Text`

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View direction="row" gap="medium">
  <Icon name="home" />
  <Icon name="wallet" tone="info" />
  <Icon name="success" tone="success" />
  <Icon name="warning" tone="warning" />
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [icon name](#icon-names) |  |
| `size` | [size](#sizes) | Default: `medium`. |
| `tone` | [tone](#tones) | Default: `default`. |

### Events

None.

## Image

A picture from your dot or from the web.

Set `aspect` to keep the space while the picture loads, and give it an `alt` for screen readers.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Image src="statics/photo.jpg" alt="A photo" aspect="16:9" fit="cover" shape="rounded" />
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | A picture in the dot's `statics/` folder, such as "statics/photo.jpg", an https address on a host in `network.hosts` in `dot.json`, or a `DotFile`'s `url`. |
| `alt` | `string` |  |
| `width` | `number` |  |
| `height` | `number` |  |
| `fit` | `cover`, `contain` | `cover` fills the box and crops. `contain` shows the whole picture. Default: `cover`. |
| `shape` | `rounded`, `square`, `circle` | Default: `rounded`. |
| `aspect` | [aspect ratio](#aspect-ratios) | The box's shape. Without a width, the picture fills the width it's given, such as the screen's, and its height follows. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onLoad` | `{ width, height }` in `detail` | The image's size in pixels. |
| `onError` | `{ message }` in `detail` |  |

> Setting `aspect` makes `height` pointless: the aspect sets the height. The build warns when both are set.

## Avatar

A person's photo in a circle, or their initials when there's no photo.

Without a photo, or when the photo doesn't load, it shows the initials of `name`: "Aminata Kamara" becomes AK.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View direction="row" gap="medium" align="center">
  <Avatar name="Aminata Kamara" image="statics/photo.jpg" size="large" />
  <Avatar name="Mohamed Sesay" size="large" />
  <Avatar name="Fatmata Conteh" />
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | The person's name, which screen readers say. |
| `image` | `string` | The person's photo. It takes the same addresses as an `Image`'s `src`. |
| `size` | [size](#sizes) | Default: `medium`. |

### Events

None.

## QRCode

Shows text, such as a payment link, as a QR code any phone can scan.

The code is always dark on light, even in dark mode. Keep `value` short: a long text makes a dense code that's harder to scan.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<QRCode value="https://example.com/pay/AC-2041" size="160" label="Payment code AC-2041" />
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  |
| `size` | `number` | In pixels. Default: `200`. |
| `label` | `string` | What screen readers say in place of the code. |

### Events

None.

## Badge

A small colored label that shows a status in a word.

Keep it to a word or two, like "Paid" or "Pending".

**Children:** Text, which can include `Text`, `Link` and `Icon` within a line

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View direction="row" gap="small">
  <Badge tone="success">Paid</Badge>
  <Badge tone="warning">Pending</Badge>
  <Badge tone="danger">Failed</Badge>
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | [status tone](#status-tones) | Default: `default`. |

### Events

None.

## Prose

Lays out articles and other long text for easy reading.

Put headings, paragraphs and lists inside it. It gives them a comfortable line length, and room between paragraphs and above headings.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Prose>
  <Text variant="title">Getting started</Text>
  <Text variant="lead">Everything you need to know before your first payment.</Text>
  <Text>Add your phone number, choose how you want to pay, and confirm the amount.</Text>
</Prose>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

None.

## RichText

Shows Markdown from your server as formatted text.

It shows headings, bold, lists, links, quotes and pictures. HTML in the Markdown shows as plain text.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<RichText markdown="{{ article }}" />
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { article: "## Opening hours\n\nWe are open **Monday to Saturday**, from 8:00 to 18:00." },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `markdown` | `string` |  |

### Events

None.

## Quote

Sets someone's words apart, with who said them.

Put the words between its tags. They get a line at the side.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Quote cite="A customer">
  <Text>Paying my bills takes a minute now.</Text>
</Quote>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cite` | `string` | Who said the words. |

### Events

None.

## BulletList

A list of points, with bullets or numbers.

Put a `Bullet` inside it for each point.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<BulletList ordered>
  <Bullet><Text>Enter the amount.</Text></Bullet>
  <Bullet><Text>Check the details.</Text></Bullet>
  <Bullet><Text>Confirm the payment.</Text></Bullet>
</BulletList>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ordered` | `boolean` | Numbers the points, as for steps. |

### Events

None.

## Bullet

One point in a BulletList, holding its text and anything else.

Goes inside a `BulletList`. It can hold text and other components.

**Children:** Components

### Example

`Bullet` is used inside `BulletList`:

```xml title="view.dml"
<BulletList ordered>
  <Bullet><Text>Enter the amount.</Text></Bullet>
  <Bullet><Text>Check the details.</Text></Bullet>
  <Bullet><Text>Confirm the payment.</Text></Bullet>
</BulletList>
```

### Props

None.

### Events

None.

## Button

A button the person taps to do something.

Use `variant="primary"` for the page's main action and `secondary` for the rest.

**Children:** Text, which can include `Text`, `Link` and `Icon` within a line

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View gap="small">
  <Button onClick="pay" loading="{{ paying }}">Pay</Button>
  <Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>
</View>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { paying: false },
  mutations: {
    pay: () => ({ paying: true }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `primary`, `secondary` | Default: `primary`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Shows a spinner and ignores taps, such as while a payment is sent. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onClick` | Nothing |  |

## Chip

A small button that can be selected, such as a filter.

A row of chips makes a filter, like Sent and Received. Keep the chosen one in the state and bind it to `selected`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View direction="row" gap="small">
  <Chip label="All" selected />
  <Chip label="Sent" icon="send" />
  <Chip label="Received" icon="download" />
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `icon` | [icon name](#icon-names) |  |
| `selected` | `boolean` | Default: `false`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTap` | Nothing |  |

## Input

A one-line field for text, numbers, a phone number or a search.

Give it a `label`: a `placeholder` disappears once the person types.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Input label="Phone number" type="phone" prefix="+232" placeholder="76 123456" value="{{ phone }}" onChange="setPhone" />
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { phone: '' },
  mutations: {
    setPhone: (_state, event: ValueEvent) => ({ phone: event.detail.value }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `hint` | `string` | Help shown under the field, which `error` replaces. |
| `error` | `string` | Shown under the field in red, in place of `hint`. |
| `prefix` | `string` | Text inside the field before what the person types, such as +232. |
| `suffix` | `string` | Text inside the field after what the person types, such as kg. |
| `type` | `text`, `number`, `email`, `phone`, `password`, `search` | `search` shows a search icon and a search key on the keyboard. Default: `text`. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | Shows a button that empties the field once it has text. |
| `maxLength` | `number` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ value }` in `detail` |  |
| `onSubmit` | `{ value }` in `detail` | When the person presses the keyboard's submit key. |

## TextArea

A field that holds a few lines of text the person types.

For one line, use an `Input`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<TextArea label="Note" placeholder="What is this payment for?" rows="3" value="{{ note }}" onChange="setNote" />
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { note: '' },
  mutations: {
    setNote: (_state, event: ValueEvent) => ({ note: event.detail.value }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `hint` | `string` | Help shown under the field, which `error` replaces. |
| `error` | `string` | Shown under the field in red, in place of `hint`. |
| `rows` | `number` | The lines of text it shows before scrolling. Default: `3`. |
| `maxLength` | `number` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ value }` in `detail` |  |

## AmountInput

A field for an amount of money, in large type.

Keep amounts in minor units, as Monime's API does, and pass them to `dash.payments.request` as they are.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<AmountInput label="Amount" value="{{ amount }}" onChange="setAmount" />
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { amount: 15000 },
  mutations: {
    setAmount: (_state, event: ValueEvent<number | null>) => ({ amount: event.detail.value }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` |  |
| `currency` | `string` | The ISO 4217 code shown before the amount. Default: `SLE`. |
| `minorUnits` | `number` | Digits after the decimal point. Default: the currency's own, 2 for SLE. |
| `unit` | `minor`, `major` | With `minor`, 150 is SLE 1.50. With `major`, 1 is SLE 1.00. Default: `minor`. |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |
| `hint` | `string` | Help shown under the field, which `error` replaces. |
| `error` | `string` | Shown under the field in red, in place of `hint`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ value }` in `detail` | The amount in `unit`, or `null` when empty. |

## CodeInput

A field for a one-time code or PIN, with a box for each digit.

Check the code in `onComplete`, not `onChange`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View gap="small">
  <CodeInput label="Enter the code we sent you" length="6" value="{{ code }}" onChange="setCode" onComplete="verify" />
  <If condition="{{ checking }}">
    <Text tone="muted">Checking your code…</Text>
  </If>
</View>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { code: '', checking: false },
  mutations: {
    setCode: (_state, event: ValueEvent) => ({ code: event.detail.value }),
    // Runs once all 6 digits are in.
    verify: (_state, event: ValueEvent) => ({ code: event.detail.value, checking: true }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  |
| `length` | `number` | Number of digits. Default: `6`. |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `hint` | `string` | Help shown under the field, which `error` replaces. |
| `error` | `string` | Shown under the field in red, in place of `hint`. |
| `secure` | `boolean` | Shows dots in place of the digits, as for a PIN. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ value }` in `detail` |  |
| `onComplete` | `{ value }` in `detail` | When every box is filled. |

## Stepper

Changes a number by steps with − and +, such as how many tickets.

For a wide range, use a `Slider`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Stepper label="Quantity" value="{{ quantity }}" min="1" max="10" onChange="setQuantity" />
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { quantity: 2 },
  mutations: {
    setQuantity: (_state, event: ValueEvent<number>) => ({ quantity: event.detail.value }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` |  |
| `min` | `number` |  |
| `max` | `number` |  |
| `step` | `number` | Default: `1`. |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `hint` | `string` | Help shown under the field, which `error` replaces. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ value }` in `detail` | The new value, as a number. |

## Slider

Chooses a number by dragging along a line.

For a small count the person changes one at a time, use a `Stepper`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Slider label="Volume" value="{{ volume }}" min="0" max="100" step="10" showValue onChange="setVolume" />
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { volume: 40 },
  mutations: {
    setVolume: (_state, event: ValueEvent<number>) => ({ volume: event.detail.value }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` |  |
| `min` | `number` | Default: `0`. |
| `max` | `number` | Default: `100`. |
| `step` | `number` | Default: `1`. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `hint` | `string` | Help shown under the field, which `error` replaces. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ value }` in `detail` | The new value, as a number. |

## Select

A field that opens a list of options to choose one from.

Put an `Option` inside it for each choice. The choices open in a sheet.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Select label="Delivery" placeholder="Choose how" value="{{ delivery }}" onChange="setDelivery">
  <Option value="pickup" label="Pick up in store" />
  <Option value="courier" label="Courier" />
  <Option value="post" label="Post" />
</Select>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { delivery: 'pickup' },
  mutations: {
    setDelivery: (_state, event: ValueEvent) => ({ delivery: event.detail.value }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | The chosen option's `value`. |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |
| `hint` | `string` | Help shown under the field, which `error` replaces. |
| `error` | `string` | Shown under the field in red, in place of `hint`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ value }` in `detail` | The chosen option's value. |

## Option

One option in a Select, with its value and the label people see.

Goes inside a `Select`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

`Option` is used inside `Select`:

```xml title="view.dml"
<Select label="Delivery" placeholder="Choose how" value="{{ delivery }}" onChange="setDelivery">
  <Option value="pickup" label="Pick up in store" />
  <Option value="courier" label="Courier" />
  <Option value="post" label="Post" />
</Select>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { delivery: 'pickup' },
  mutations: {
    setDelivery: (_state, event: ValueEvent) => ({ delivery: event.detail.value }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | What the `Select`'s `onChange` sends when the person chooses this option. |
| `label` | `string` | What the person sees. |

### Events

None.

## Switch

An on and off switch for a setting that applies at once.

For a choice the person confirms with a button, use a `Checkbox`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Switch label="Notify me of payments" checked="{{ notify }}" onChange="setNotify" />
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { notify: true },
  mutations: {
    setNotify: (_state, event: CheckedEvent) => ({ notify: event.detail.checked }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `boolean` | Default: `false`. |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ checked }` in `detail` |  |

A box the person ticks to agree or to choose an option.

| Prop | Type | What it is |

| `checked` | `boolean` | Default: `false`. |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ checked }` in `detail` |  |

| Event | Sends | Notes |

## Radio

One option in a RadioGroup, with its value and the label people see.

Goes inside a `RadioGroup`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<RadioGroup label="Pay with" value="{{ method }}" onChange="setMethod">
  <Radio value="mobile-money" label="Mobile money" />

</RadioGroup>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { method: 'mobile-money' },
```

## List

A list of rows in a card, which can load more rows as the person scrolls.

Put a `ListItem` inside it for each row.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<List>
  <ListItem icon="send" title="Sent to Aminata" subtitle="Today, 09:41" value="SLE 50.00" />
  <ListItem icon="download" title="From Mohamed" subtitle="Yesterday" value="SLE 120.00" />
</List>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `sm`, `md` |  |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onEndReached` | Nothing | The last row scrolled into view. Add more rows here to load as the person scrolls. |

## ListItem

One row in a List: a title, a subtitle, an icon or picture, and a value or badge at the end.

Anything you put inside it, such as a `Badge`, shows at the end in place of `value`.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<List>
  <ListItem icon="receipt" title="Electricity" subtitle="Meter 0412 3456 789" onTap="open" data-id="electricity">
    <Badge tone="warning">Due</Badge>
  </ListItem>
</List>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: {},
  actions: {
    open(_state, event: DataEvent<{ id: string }>) {
      this.navigation.push('bill', { id: event.data.id });
    },
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  |
| `value` | `string` |  |
| `icon` | [icon name](#icon-names) |  |
| `image` | `string` | A picture at the start of the row, in place of `icon`. It takes the same addresses as an `Image`'s `src`. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTap` | Nothing | A tappable item shows a chevron. |

## DetailRow

A label and its value on one line, such as a line of a receipt.

Long values wrap and stay on the right.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View variant="card" gap="none">
  <DetailRow label="Reference" value="AC-2041" />
  <DetailRow label="Status" value="Paid" tone="success" />
  <DetailRow label="Total" value="SLE 120.00" weight="bold" />
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `value` | `string` |  |
| `tone` | [tone](#tones) | The value's tone and weight. The label is always muted. |
| `weight` | `regular`, `medium`, `bold` | Default: `regular`. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

None.

## Disclosure

A row the person opens to show more, then closes again.

Put what it reveals between its tags.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Disclosure title="Can I get a refund?" subtitle="Payments" open>
  <Text>Yes, within 24 hours of paying.</Text>
</Disclosure>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  |
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether it starts open. After that, the person opens and closes it. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onToggle` | `{ open }` in `detail` | Whether the person opened or closed it. |

## Steps

Shows the stages of something, such as a payment's progress.

Put a `Step` inside it for each stage.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Steps>
  <Step title="Paid" text="Today, 09:41" status="done" />
  <Step title="Sent" text="On its way" status="current" />
  <Step title="Received" status="upcoming" />
</Steps>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

None.

## Step

One stage in Steps: done, current, upcoming or failed.

Goes inside `Steps`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

`Step` is used inside `Steps`:

```xml title="view.dml"
<Steps>
  <Step title="Paid" text="Today, 09:41" status="done" />
  <Step title="Sent" text="On its way" status="current" />
  <Step title="Received" status="upcoming" />
</Steps>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  |
| `text` | `string` | Under the title, such as when it happened. |
| `status` | `done`, `current`, `upcoming`, `failed` | `done` and `failed` already happened, `current` is under way, and `upcoming` hasn't started. |

### Events

None.

## Tabs

A row of tabs, where one is chosen at a time.

Put a `Tab` inside it for each tab. Tabs only choose: show each tab's content yourself, with an `<If>`.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Tabs value="{{ tab }}" variant="segmented" onChange="setTab">
  <Tab value="all" label="All" />
  <Tab value="sent" label="Sent" />
  <Tab value="received" label="Received" badge="3" />
</Tabs>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { tab: 'all' },
  mutations: {
    setTab: (_state, event: ValueEvent) => ({ tab: event.detail.value }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | The chosen tab's `value`. |
| `variant` | `underline`, `segmented` | `underline` marks the chosen tab with a line. `segmented` fills it in, in a rounded track. Default: `underline`. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onChange` | `{ value }` in `detail` | The chosen tab's value. |

## Tab

One tab in Tabs, with its label and an optional count badge.

Goes inside `Tabs`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

`Tab` is used inside `Tabs`:

```xml title="view.dml"
<Tabs value="{{ tab }}" variant="segmented" onChange="setTab">
  <Tab value="all" label="All" />
  <Tab value="sent" label="Sent" />
  <Tab value="received" label="Received" badge="3" />
</Tabs>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { tab: 'all' },
  mutations: {
    setTab: (_state, event: ValueEvent) => ({ tab: event.detail.value }),
  },
```

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | What the `Tabs`' `onChange` sends when the person chooses this tab. |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `badge` | `number` | A count shown next to the label, such as unread items. |

None.

## Notice

A message on the page, such as a warning or why a payment failed.

Add `onClose` to give it a close button.

**Children:** Text, which can include `Text`, `Link` and `Icon` within a line

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<Notice tone="info" title="Scheduled maintenance">Payments may be slow on Sunday from 02:00 to 04:00.</Notice>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | [status tone](#status-tones) | Default: `default`. |
| `title` | `string` |  |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onClose` | Nothing | The person tapped the close button. Hide the notice with an `<If>`. |

## Toast

A short message that shows over the page for a moment, such as \"Copied\".

Keep one `Toast` on the page and set `message` to show it. To show the same text twice, clear `message` in `onHide`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View>
  <Button variant="secondary" onClick="copy">Copy reference</Button>
  <Toast message="{{ toast }}" tone="success" onHide="clearToast" />
</View>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { toast: '' },
  mutations: {
    copy: () => ({ toast: 'Copied' }),
    clearToast: () => ({ toast: '' }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `string` | The text to show. The toast shows each time it changes. |
| `tone` | [status tone](#status-tones) | Default: `default`. |
| `duration` | `number` | In milliseconds. Default: `2500`. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onHide` | Nothing | The toast hid. |

## Sheet

A panel that slides up from the bottom, over the page.

The sheet doesn't close on its own: set `open` back to false in `onClose`.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View>
  <Button variant="secondary" onClick="openSheet">Payment options</Button>
  <Sheet open="{{ open }}" title="Payment" onClose="close">
    <Button variant="secondary" onClick="close">Copy reference</Button>
    <Button onClick="close">Done</Button>
  </Sheet>
</View>
```

```ts title="controller.ts"
export default definePage({
  initialState: { open: false },
  mutations: {
    openSheet: () => ({ open: true }),
    close: () => ({ open: false }),
  },
});
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the sheet shows. |
| `title` | `string` |  |
| `showCloseIcon` | `boolean` | Shows a close button in the corner. Tapping it sends `onClose`, as tapping outside does. |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

| Event | Sends | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onClose` | Nothing | The person tapped outside it or its close button. |

## Spinner

A small spinning circle that shows something is loading.

For a list or a card that's loading, a `Skeleton` in its shape keeps the page from jumping.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View direction="row" gap="medium" align="center">
  <Spinner size="small" />
  <Spinner />
  <Spinner size="large" />
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | [size](#sizes) |  |

### Events

None.

## ProgressBar

A bar that fills up to show how far along something is.

Use it when you know how far along something is, such as an upload. When you don't, use a `Spinner`.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View gap="small">
  <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">Uploading, 60%</Text>
  <ProgressBar value="60" />
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | How far along it is, from 0 to 100. |

### Events

None.

## Skeleton

A gray placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading.

Give it the size of what's loading. The page then doesn't jump when the content arrives.

**Children:** Nothing

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<View gap="small">
  <Skeleton shape="circle" height="48" />
  <Skeleton shape="text" lines="2" />
</View>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `text`, `circle`, `box` | Default: `text`. |
| `lines` | `number` | Lines of text, for `text`. Default: `1`. |
| `height` | `number` | In pixels, for `circle` and `box`. |

### Events

None.

## EmptyState

What to show where there's nothing yet, such as an empty list.

Put a button inside it to give the person a way forward.

**Children:** Components

### Example

```xml title="view.dml"
<EmptyState icon="receipt" title="No payments yet" text="Payments you make will show here.">
  <Button variant="secondary">Make a payment</Button>
</EmptyState>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | [icon name](#icon-names) |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |
| `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd`, `paddingBottom` | [spacing](#spacing) | Space inside its edges, all round or on one side. |

### Events

None.
